tasks.subject: Task 2: Pace calculator and goal check
tasks.description:
**Goal:** PaceCalculator derives training paces and judges whether a goal time is plausible.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/TrainingPaces.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/GoalAssessment.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/PaceCalculator.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PaceCalculatorTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 25:00 5K goal gives 573/508/483/483
- [ ] 50:00 10K goal gives 553/488/463/483
- [ ] Just finish with a 30:00 5K race for 10K gives 669/604/579/604
- [ ] Just finish with no race uses defaults
- [ ] Goal check: reachable, 14 weeks, and no suggestion cases

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter PaceCalculatorTests

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-plan-generation.md

tasks.subject: Task 3: Workout builder and walk-run ladder
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One function per planned workout kind plus the walk-run ladder, with intervals and tempo of equal length.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/Scaling.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/WalkRunLevel.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/WorkoutBuilder.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/WorkoutBuilderTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each workout kind produces the exact steps, paces and title in the tests
- [ ] Intervals last exactly as long as tempo at levels 15 to 50 for both distances
- [ ] Walk-run running time never drops between rungs
- [ ] Walk-run sessions have no pace targets

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter WorkoutBuilderTests

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-plan-generation.md

tasks.subject: Task 4: Plan generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** PlanGenerator.generate turns a profile into dated weeks of workouts.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/PlanGenerator.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PlanGeneratorTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Worked examples match exactly
- [ ] Every goal x fitness x 2-5 days x 6-16 weeks gives a valid plan ending in one time trial
- [ ] Build weeks grow at most 10% plus 60 s per workout; cutbacks at most 80% plus 60 s per workout
- [ ] Same profile gives the same plan apart from IDs

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter PlanGeneratorTests

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-plan-generation.md

```json:metadata
{"files":["RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Planning/PlanGenerator.swift","RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PlanGeneratorTests.swift"],"verifyCommand":"swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter PlanGeneratorTests","acceptanceCriteria":["Worked examples match exactly","Every goal x fitness x 2-5 days x 6-16 weeks gives a valid plan ending in one time trial","Build weeks grow at most 10% plus 60 s per workout; cutbacks at most 80% plus 60 s per workout","Same profile gives the same plan apart from IDs"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Plan queries, completion, edits and storage
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Plan finds the next workout, marks completion and replaces edits; PlanStore saves plan.json.

- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Storage/PlanStore.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PlanTests.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/PlanStoreTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] nextWorkout skips missed and completed workouts and is nil after the plan
- [ ] markCompleted sets recordID; unknown IDs change nothing
- [ ] update replaces by ID and keeps the week in date order
- [ ] Saved plan loads back equal; missing loads nil

**Verify:** swift test in RunCore via WSL --filter Plan

Full steps and code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-plan-generation.md
